import subprocess, json, sys, time
base = json.dumps({"version":3,"cases":[]}).encode()
big = b' ' * (16*1024*1024 - len(base)) + base          # exactly 16 MiB
over = b' ' * (16*1024*1024 - len(base) + 1) + base     # 16 MiB + 1
for name, raw in (('exact16MiB', big), ('over16MiB', over)):
    t=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=raw,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=600)
    print(name, p.returncode, p.stdout[:60], 'rc', p.returncode, '%.2fs'%(time.time()-t), 'in', len(raw))
